summary: Extends the IMAP LIST command so a client can ask for STATUS information, such as message counts, in the same request. Without it, clients must list all mailboxes and then ask for status of each one separately. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking for a list of boxes and then asking about each one, you ask for the list and counts in one go.

questions: get mailbox message counts with list
imap unseen count for all mailboxes
